## Content checklist (for words and templates)

- [ ] Every word is real (or a deliberate coinage in a coinage pack) and spelled correctly, diacritics included
- [ ] Filth bands are honest (see `docs/research/CONTENT_POLICY.md`)
- [ ] Nothing here is a slur, ableist, body-shaming, gendered, sexual, or about a real person, including by origin
- [ ] Neutral descriptors carry `targets` so they only land where they make sense
- [ ] Foreign entries have a gloss with gender; a fluent speaker has looked (or you have said so below)
- [ ] `npm run check` is green
- [ ] I read a transcript (`npx tsx scripts/transcript.ts --seed <anything>`) and laughed at least once
